newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank of Lebanon weekly CDs raise 10 bln pounds.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Lebanon weekly CDs raise 10 bln pounds.

text.p: The Bank of Lebanon issued on Thursday certificates of deposit dated October 25 to commercial banks worth 10 billion Lebanese pounds compared with 62 billion last week.
The Bank sold 45-day CDs worth two billion pounds compared with six billion last week. It sold 60-day CDs worth eight billion pounds compared with 56 billion last week.
Interest rates on the 45- and 60-day CDs were 12.75 percent and 13.50 percent respectively, unchanged for the seventh week running.
